data.one_liner: Flutter library to create radio button groups and radio buttons with labels.
data.what_it_does: Provides single RadioButton and RadioButtonGroup widgets to display options with text descriptions and labels. Simplifies managing group selection state and custom item styling.
use_when: You need to display a group of radio buttons with labels in a Flutter form.
You want a simple way to manage selected values among multiple options.
avoid_when: You need complex form validation or form builder integration not covered by basic state management.
strengths: Easy to use with a builder pattern for radio groups.
Supports customizable text styles and selection colors.
weaknesses: Limited advanced features documented beyond basic radio group creation.
